span.span: existing works overlook the impact of differences in data feature dimensions, resulting in global models that disproportionately depend on participants with large feature dimensions.

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 真实的联邦场景中，不同机构（节点）的数据维度可能天差地别，比如大医院的特征维度远高于小诊所

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 或忽略此差异，导致训练出的全局模型会不公平地偏向于高维特征节点，使得低维节点的重要信息被忽视，这违背了联邦学习“集众家之长”的初衷

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 对多视图数据的处理能力不足

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: current single-view federated learning methods fail to account for the unique characteristics of multi-view data, leading to suboptimal performance in processing such data.

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 现实世界的数据天然就是多视图的（例如，一个人的数据可能包含影像、病理、基因等多个视图）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 传统的联邦学习算法是为单视图数据设计的，无法有效挖掘多视图数据中跨视图的一致性和互补性信息，因此在这些数据上表现不佳

n(行数)​​: 代表​​样本数量​​

span.span: 不同的节点（视图）其 d_k 值可以​​各不相同​​。例如，一个节点的特征可能是文本词频（维度很高），而另一个节点的特征可能是数值统计数据（维度较低）

span.span: 在垂直联邦学习（VFL）的设定下，所有参与方拥有​​相同的样本集合​​（例如同一批用户），但每个参与方持有这些样本的​​不同特征​​。因此，样本数量 n在所有节点间是保持一致和对齐的

span.span: Cᵏ： 一致性子(共有）空间，旨在捕捉所有视图共享的公共数据结构
样本间内在关联结构

span.span: Uᵏ： 视图特异性子空间，旨在捕捉仅属于当前视图k的独特模式
第 k个视图的独特特征所揭示的样本关系

span.span: Xᵏ(Cᵏ + Uᵏ)： 这是重构后的数据

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 物理意义是：每个重构的样本（该矩阵的每一列），都是原始数据集中所有样本的加权线性组合
权重
则由Cᵏ + Uᵏ矩阵中对应列的元素提供

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Xᵏ - Xᵏ(Cᵏ + Uᵏ)： 这是重构误差矩阵，即原始数据与重构数据之间的逐元素差值

span.span: ‖·‖_F²： Frobenius范数的平方。它计算的是矩阵中所有元素平方之和。
最小化这个值意味着要同时减小所有样本、所有特征维度上的重构误差

span.span: 通过最小化重构误差，强制要求模型学习一个维度统一为n×n的子空间表示（Cᵏ + Uᵏ） 这个表示必须同时包含公共信息（Cᵏ）和特异信息（Uᵏ），且两者通力合作，才能最大限度地还原原始数据 这项为Cᵏ和Uᵏ的分解提供了最基本的驱动力和合理性保障

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

span.span: 如果Cᵏ和Uᵏ加起来都不能很好地解释我本地的数据Xᵏ，那么后续基于它们进行的任何联邦聚合（融合Cᵏ）和超图构建（利用Uᵏ）都将是
无本之木

span.span: 在上述的项描述中可以想到： 既然是共有那C的对角线应该是1，而U应该是0 那就会有问题，会出现平凡解（Trivial Solution）

让 Zᵏ成为一个​​单位矩阵 I​​

span.span: “ 如无必要，勿增实体 ”
在同样能够解释观测数据（即重构误差小）的模型中，
越简单的模型越可能接近真理，也越具泛化能力

span.span: 并不关心Cᵏ内部的具体结构，而是简单地约束其所有元素的平方和不能过大

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 通过最小化该项，模型被引导去寻找那些
能够较好地重构数据
（满足第一项），但同时其
系数值又尽可能小的解

非常复杂、数值巨大
的Cᵏ矩阵，从而
降低了过拟合
的风险

即 ‖Cᵏ‖F² = Σ_i Σ_j (c{ij})²

span.span: 会倾向于让矩阵元素 c_{ij}的值尽可能小，因为任何较大的值都会导致 c_{ij}²对总目标函数产生很大的贡献，这与最小化目标的目标相悖

span.span: 旨在学习到一个​​不过于复杂​​的共识表示，避免其过度依赖某个节点或某些样本

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: λ₁： 正则化强度超参数。它是一个大于零的标量，用于控制该项在整体目标函数中的重要性。
λ₁越大，意味着我们对Cᵏ的“简单性”要求越高，对其数值大小的惩罚力度也越大

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 组合原理

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 作为重构误差项的“合作伙伴”，它通过惩罚一致性子空间Cᵏ的Frobenius范数，来平衡模型的“拟合能力”和“泛化能力”。它与第一项重构误差项共同作用，引导模型学习到一个既能够有效表征数据内在公共结构，又不过于复杂、对噪声鲁棒的一致性表示

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 没有这一项，模型可能会找到一个在训练数据上重构误差极小的Cᵏ，但这个Cᵏ可能包含了大量为了拟合特定噪声而产生的无意义大数值系数，导致其在未知数据上表现很差（过拟合）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 流形结构约束项（Manifold Structure Term）​

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 核心思想

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 保持局部样本关系的一致性

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 如果两个样本点在原始特征空间中非常接近（是“近邻”），那么它们在所学到的一致性子空间Cᵏ中的表达也应该是相似的

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 约束的不仅仅是Cᵏ的整体大小（如第二项所做的那样），而是
Cᵏ的内部结构

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 要求子空间系数矩阵Cᵏ能够反映出原始数据的局部
几何
性质。
样本间的“邻近”关系，应该忠实地映射到子空间系数的“相似”关系上

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 项的分解与符号解读

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Cᵏ： 一致性子空间系数矩阵（n × n）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Mᵏ： 流形系数矩阵（n × n）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一个预先计算好的、固定不变的矩阵，它编码了原始数据Xᵏ的局部几何结构

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 如何得到？

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 公式(3)所示，Mᵏ的每个元素mᵏ_ij 代表了样本i和j之间的局部邻近关系

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 分子 ||x_i^k - x_j^k||_2是样本 i和 j之间的欧氏距离，衡量两者的​​原始特征相似性

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 分母 Σ_{t≠i} ||x_t^k - x_j^k||_2是样本 j与所有其他样本距离的总和，用于​​行归一化​​

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 对角线置零​​：矩阵的对角线元素 m_ii^k被强制设为0，以避免自循环

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 因此，m_{ij}^{k}可以解释为：
样本 j在表达样本 i时，其所占的​​比重​​或​​重要性
​​。两个样本在原始空间中
越接近（距离越小），这个值就越大

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: m_ij^k的值越大，表示
样本 j在样本 i的“邻域”中相对越​​远​​（因为分子是距离）
反之，值越小，表示样本 j在样本 i的邻域中相对越​​近​​。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: ⊙： 哈达玛积，即矩阵的逐元素相乘

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 结果矩阵中每个元素的值是 (Mᵏ)_{ij} × (Cᵏ)_{ij}

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 流形系数矩阵 Mᵏ中的每一个值作为一个​​权重​​，作用在子空间 Cᵏ的每一个元素上。这使得优化过程能够对 Cᵏ中不同位置的关系施加不同强度的约束。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 如果两个样本在原始特征空间中很接近（即 m_ij^k 值小），那么它们在子空间表示 C^k 中也应该具有相似的关系（即 Cijk的值也应变小，以使它们的乘积最小化）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: ‖Mᵏ ⊙ Cᵏ‖_F²： 这是对加权后的子空间系数求Frobenius范数平方

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 它等于 Σ_i Σ_j (m_ij * c_ij)²

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 组合原理

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 它
通过一个预定义的流形矩阵Mᵏ，对一致性子空间Cᵏ的学习过程进行
局部性地、有区分性地引导 它
不强求所有样本间的关系都一致
而是鼓励在原始数据流形上邻近的样本，在子空间中也拥有较强的连接（c_ij值较大） 而对于流形上相距较远的样本，则允许甚至鼓励它们的子空间连接较弱（c_ij值较小） 这使得学到的Cᵏ不仅是一个有效的表示，更是一个能反映数据内在本质结构的表示

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 不是强约束，而是不让其过于变化大

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 情况一：两个样本在流形上非常接近（是近邻）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: m_ij 的值很大（接近1）。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 此时，(m_ij * c_ij)² 这个惩罚项的大小主要取决于 c_ij。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 模型的优化策略：为了最小化整个目标函数，模型会倾向于让 c_ij 成为一个不受约束的、合理的值。因为 m_ij 已经很大了，如果 c_ij 也很大，惩罚会非常重。但如果数据本身确实要求这两个相似样本在子空间中有强连接（即 c_ij 需要大），重构误差项（第一项）会推动 c_ij 变大。最终，模型会在重构需求和流形平滑需求之间找到一个平衡点，允许 c_ij 保持一个较大的值。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 简单来说：对于近邻样本，此项约束允许并鼓励 c_ij 有较大的值，只要它符合数据的重构规律。它并不强制缩小 c_ij。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 情况二：两个样本在流形上不相近（非近邻）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: m_ij 的值很小甚至为0。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 此时，无论 c_ij 有多大，(m_ij * c_ij)² 这个惩罚项都会非常小。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 模型的优化策略：对于非近邻样本，这项约束几乎不产生任何惩罚。这意味着，模型在决定这两个样本之间的子空间关系 c_ij 时，几乎是自由的！它完全可以只根据重构误差（第一项）的需要来设定 c_ij 的大小，而不用考虑流形结构。

span.span: 它与第二项（λ₁‖Cᵏ‖_F²）
协同
工作，共同规范了
“一致性-特异性”分解过程
通过惩罚Uᵏ的Frobenius范数，它确保了
视图特异性信息的学习是“克制的”和“补充性的”
防止Uᵏ过度解释数据
，从而迫使模型将尽可能多的通用信息压入一致性子空间Cᵏ中 这使得最终的分解结果更加清晰和有意义

span.span: 传统的成对关系图（每条边只能连接两个样本）难以描述现实数据中复杂的群体关系
超图
允许一条边（称为
超边
）连接多个样本，从而能更自然地表示样本之间的
高阶相似性

span.span: ​​顶点 (Vertices)​​：V中的每个顶点 vi对应数据集中的一个样本。共有 n个顶点

span.span: 超边 (Hyperedges)​​：E中的每条超边 ej不再只是连接两个顶点，而是可以连接​​一组顶点​​。 论文中采用了一种常见构造方法：​​为每个样本构建一条超边​​。 也就是说，会有 n条超边

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 对于每个顶点 vj，我们根据全局亲和力矩阵 A的第 j行（或列，因为A通常对称），找到与 vj最相似的 k个顶点（包括v j自己）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 最终的聚类决策不应仅仅基于成对的样本相似性，而应基于更丰富的、从多视图数据中学习到的群体性关系

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 最小化这个迹，就是寻找一个 F，使得其列向量（即簇的方向）在 L_h所定义的超图结构上尽可能“平滑”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 强制聚类结果与超图结构一致（核心作用）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 超图 L_h的构建融合了全局和视图特异性信息，它编码了样本间复杂的高阶相似关系。一条超边连接多个样本，意味着这些样本在某个视角下属于一个“小团体”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 项值变小时​​： 要求属于​​同一条超边​​的样本，在聚类结果 F中，​​尽可能地被分配到同一个簇中

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​项值变大时​​： 允许属于同一条超边的样本被随意地划分到不同的簇，这会导致聚类结果与数据内在的相似结构不一致，产生错误的分类

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 保证簇内的“紧致性”

span.span: 被切割掉的超边的权重尽可能小​​

span.span: 闭式解（Closed-form Solution）​​： 首先忽略约束，通过令梯度为零，直接得到无约束解 C̃ᵏ的解析解（公式(13)）

span.span: ​​投影（Projection）​​： 然后，利用​​Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) 条件​​，求解公式(15)的拉格朗日函数，得到满足所有约束（非负、仿射、对角线为零）的最优 Cᵏ的迭代更新公式（公式(17)）

span.span: 论文中的公式
对特有空间 Uᵏ 的约束（仅平滑性）而对共享空间 Cᵏ 的约束（平滑性 + 流形结构），可不可以加上一个约束

span.span: 真正“特有”的信息，应该是其他视图所没有的。因此，不同视图的特有模式应该尽可能不同（即正交），从而最大化信息的互补性

这意味着像常用的k近邻（k-NN）等方法，在构建超边时只关注每个样本最邻近的少数几个点，视野较为狭窄

span.span: ​​Co-GCN (Li et al., 2020)​​：​​经典的多视图GCN方法​​。通过自适应利用多视图的图信息和组合拉普拉斯矩阵，将GCN引入多视图学习。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​GCN-fusion​​：一种基础的基线方法。让每个视图用自己的图独立运行GCN，然后聚合这些GCN模型的预测结果。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​ERL-MVC (Huang et al., 2021)​​：一种通过嵌入正则化器学习方案来整合多视图数据并挖掘稀疏局部结构的半监督分类算法。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​DSRL (Wang et al., 2022)​​：一种​​SOTA方法​​。通过具有可微分、可重用块的神经网络自适应学习深度稀疏正则化器，以提取判别性特征。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​JFGCN (Chen, Wu et al., 2023)​​：一种​​SOTA的端到端联合融合框架​​。旨在实现一致的特征集成和自适应的拓扑调整，以捕获多视图数据的一致性和互补性。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​GEGCN (Lu, Wu, Zhong et al., 2024)​​：一种​​较新的SOTA方法​​。通过提取共享表示、构建相干图，并引入带有可学习阈值收缩函数的去噪GCN来增强图嵌入的纯度。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​ECMGD (Lu, Wu, Chen et al., 2024)​​：一种​​较新的SOTA能量约束多视图图扩散框架​​。通过考虑系统内视图间和视图内的特征流，设计了具有视图间感知的特征传播过程。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​ORLNet (Fang et al., 2024)​​：一种将优化派生组件集成到深度网络中的方法，确保了可解释性和灵活性。

span.span: 核心背景

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​real-world data correlations go beyond pairwise associations​​, and samples within the same class in the feature space are not always highly similar which may ​​surpass the modeling capacity of a simple graph structure​​.
现实世界的数据关联超越了成对的关联，并且特征空间中同一类别的样本并不总是高度相似，这可能超出了简单图结构的建模能力

span.span: ​​关联的复杂性​​

span.span: 如Fig. 1所示，k-NN在​​类别边界模糊（即类别重叠）​​ 的区域难以做出准确判断，容易产生错误的连接

span.span: For instance, in the task of categorizing a collection of papers into various topics, the relationships among these papers may exhibit a group-like pattern, where multiple papers share a common author.
以“论文分类”为例，指出“共享同一作者”这种​​群体性关系（高阶关联）​​ 是简单图难以表达的。如果某位作者涉及多个领域（造成类别重叠），基于局部相似性的方法很容易出错

span.span: To promote message exchange across nodes on different hyperedges, we ​​explore the scalability of hypergraph adjacency​​ in a multi-view setting by ​​concatenating hypergraphs from each view​​.
为了促进不同超边上节点间的消息交换，我们通过拼接每个视图的超图，探索了多视图设置中超图邻接的可扩展性.

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: 通过​​拼接（Concat）​​ 各视图的关联矩阵，简单而有效地将超图扩展到多视图维度，从而允许节点在不同视图的超边中进行信息交互

span.span: 一个三分类模型（猫、狗、兔）在判断一张图片。对于某张猫的图片，模型的输出可能是 Z=[0.85,0.10,0.05]。这意味着模型有85%的把握认为是猫，10%的把握认为是狗，5%的把握认为是兔子。 Z_lf（对应第l样本属于是类别f的可置信率）就是这其中某一个数值，比如代表“猫”的那个0.85

span.span: 对于样本 l，如果它的真实类别是 f，则 Y _lf =1，否则 Y_lf =0。它是一个​​开关函数

span.span: 接着上面的例子，既然图片是真猫，那么它的真实标签就是 Y=[1,0,0]。Y_lf 就是这其中某一个数值，代表“猫”的那个位置是1，其他都是0

span.span: 由于 Y_lf是“开关”，两者相乘的结果是 ​​
只有当 f是样本 l的真实类别时，该项才等于 lnZ_lf（即模型预测为真实类别的概率的对数），否则该项为0​​
这确保了损失函数只关心模型对​​正确类别​​的预测值。

span.span: 整个求和的结果是一个很大的负数 加上一个负号后，损失 L就变成了一个​​正数​​ 我们的优化目标是​​最小化损失​​，因此最小化 L就等价于​​最大化 lnZ_lf ​​，也就是
​​最大化模型预测为真实类别的概率 Z_lf​​

span.span: 核心的非线性变换 —— 超图卷积​ 是 Z^lf计算的
核心循环
，通常进行多次（如2层），
每一次都使节点特征包含更高阶的邻域信息

span.span: 归一化是​​为了控制数值稳定性和避免偏差

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: D_e^−1 把“超边收到的总信号”除以“该超边连接的节点数”，于是大超边不再因为“接了很多节点”而累积出过大的数值，而是被归一化成“平均每个节点贡献多少”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​ 是对称归一化（源自图拉普拉斯矩阵），用于平衡不同节点度的影响。一个连接众多超边的“热门”节点，其度很大，通过归一化可以削弱其影响力，防止其特征在传播中主导整个系统

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: 原始 L 有个缺点：度大的节点对应行和很大，数值尺度不一

span.span: 于是把左右两边都除以度的平方根：

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: Θ^(l)： 这是第 l层的一个
可学习参数矩阵
，维度为 d_l×d_(l+1)。它用于对
特征进行线性变换（旋转变换）

span.span: 是
神经网络​​学习和适应的核心
​​ 通过
反向传播和梯度下降优化这个参数矩阵
，模型可以学习到如何将输入特征映射到更有利于下游任务（如分类）的新特征空间中去

span.span: 模型如果错误地​​
漏报
（False Negative）​​ 了一个正样本，或者对其预测的置信度不高，将会产生一个被放大 (Nq−/Nq+) β倍的巨大损失，从而强烈地“惩罚”模型，迫使它在后续的优化中必须努力纠正对这个正样本的错误

span.span: 它首先
计算出基础的、带符号的预测误差
，然后通过
合页函数
过滤掉那些
已经被“足够好”地预测的样本
，从而
聚焦于分类边界附近和判断错误的样本
，实现鲁棒性。紧接着，它
对剩余的有效误差进行平方放大
，并乘上一个能
动态提升稀有正样本权重的矩阵M
，最终将所有
调整后的损失汇总
。其根本目的是在优化过程中，
强制模型“睁开眼”去看那些稀少的正样本
，并“放开手”不去纠结于个别异常点

W⋅,q即
权重矩阵W的第q列）应该是稀疏的
大部分权重为零，只有少数几个权重非零
。这些非零权重所对应的特征，就是
驱动该标签预测的关键“标签特定特征”

span.span: 它在模型的核心优化目标（拟合数据）之上，施加了一个追求
“简洁”
的附加约束。通过将
权重矩阵W的L1范数作为惩罚项加入总损失中
，它引导优化算法去寻找这样一个解：在
保证预测准确性的同时
，尽
可能多地“关闭”不重要的特征通道
。这使得最终的模型权重矩阵W呈现出
明显的稀疏性
，每一列非零元素所对应的特征，就自然而然地被选择为对应标签的“特定特征”

span.span: 考虑乘积 WRW^T 它的第 (i, j) 元素是∑k,qWikRkqWjq。当我们取它的迹时，就是在对所有的特征维度 i 求和。最小化 Tr 本质上是要求：
对于所有特征，如果两个标签 k 和 q 是相关的 R_{kq} 小），那么该特征在这两个标签上的权重 W_{ik} 和 W_{iq} 应该趋于相似

span.span: 它充当了连接不同标签分类器的“知识桥梁”。通过将
标签相关性矩阵 R 作为正则化器引入目标函数
，它
迫使模型在学习过程中不仅考虑每个标签自身的训练数据，还要考虑其与其他标签的关系网络
。其优化方向是：让在标签关系网络中被
“强边”连接的标签
，其
在特征空间中的决策边界（由 W 的列向量定义）也彼此靠近
，从而
实现知识的共享与迁移
，提升模型整体的协调性和泛化能力

span.span: 它将多标签数据中天然的“
标签-样本
”隶属关系（一个标签对应一组样本），直接转化为一个强大的数据结构——
超图
。然后，利用谱图理论，将“局部平滑性”这一直觉概念形式化为一个可优化的数学项。通过
最小化该项，模型被强制要求其输出 F 在超图 Hs 上必须是平滑的
，即
被同一超边（同一标签）紧密连接的样本群体，其预测结果也高度一致
。这极大地利用了标签信息来指导分类边界的形状，从而提升性能

span.span: 一个可学习机制
：这是关键创新之一（U₅）。他们不满足于静态地构建超图，而是引入了一个可学习的机制，使得超图结构本身能够被优化

span.span: 一个动态扩散模型
：他们利用这个模型来“动态学习”统一的超图结构。这意味着超图不是在预处理阶段固定死的，而是在训练过程中，随着分类任务的需求而不断被调整和精炼的

span.span: 然后使用优化器（如Adam）根据梯度更新这些参数

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 过程的精妙之处在于：梯度会像链条一样，从损失 L → 分类器 → Xₙ(T) → ... → 一直回溯到最源头的可学习超图 Hᵤ

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 如果某个超边连接了对分类没有帮助的节点
，那么通过这个超边传递的信息很可能对生成好的 Xₙ(T) 没有贡献，甚至有害。反映在损失上，就是 L 会比较大。在反向传播时，Hᵤ 中对应这个无用超边的连接强度就会被减弱

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 反之，如果某种连接模式（体现在 Hᵤ 的某些值上）反复被证明对分类有益
，那么这些连接就会被强化

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 最终，系统学会的不是一个固定的规则，而是一种“能力”：如何根据分类任务的目标，自动构建出最合适的超图组织方式

span.span: 这些规则简单有效，但
僵化且与最终任务脱节
它无法发现“一个设计师+一个后端+一个产品经理”这种跨领域的、但对完成某个创新项目至关重要的团队组合

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: “我们不要自己定规则了，我们让最终的任务目标（分类准确率）来告诉模型，什么样的团队组合（超图结构）才是最有效的。”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 信息根据当前的 Hᵤ 在节点和超边之间流动，经过T步后，得到节点表示 X_n(T)

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: X_n(T) 被送入分类器，得到预测 Ŷ，并最终计算出损失 L

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 反向传播

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 计算损失 L 对 Hᵤ 中每一个元素的梯度：∂L / ∂Hᵤ(i, e)

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 这个梯度值
量化了“改变节点i与超边e的连接强度，会对最终分类损失产生多大影响”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 如果梯度是负的，说明增强这个连接有助于降低损失（提高分类准确率），那么在下一步优化中，Hᵤ(i, e) 的值会增大

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 如果梯度是正的，说明这个连接目前是有害的，那么 Hᵤ(i, e) 的值会减小

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 参数更新

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: “初始化 + 任务驱动进化”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 提供一个有学习潜力的起点
：通过MLP等方式初始化 Hᵤ，使其并非完全随机，蕴含一定的结构信息

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 嵌入一个可迭代的系统
：将 Hᵤ 置于一个动态的消息传递系统（LUHDS）中，使其能影响节点表示的生成

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 接受最终目标的指导
：利用下游任务（半监督分类）的监督信号（损失梯度）作为唯一的、也是最有效的指导，来不断修正 Hᵤ 的结构

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 实现闭环优化
：最终学到的 Hᵤ，是一个为特定任务“量身定制”的最优关系拓扑，它能够最有效地从多视图数据中提炼出对分类有用的高阶信息

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 动态扩散系统

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 核心思想：受物理学和ODE启发的信息动力学

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 传统的图神经网络（GNN）进行信息传递，可以看作是在一个
固定的、离散的
结构上进行有限步的聚合

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 动态扩散系统，其核心思想是
将信息在超图上的传播模拟为一个连续的动态系统
，灵感来源于描述物理现象（如热扩散）的
常微分方程

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: 稳定性：可以通过ODE理论分析系统的行为，确保它不会失控（如数值爆炸）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(80, 56, 21); text-align: left;

span.span: ODE（Ordinary Differential Equation，常微分方程）​​ 是包含一个自变量、未知函数及其导数的方程，描述系统状态随时间的变化规律

span.span: Abstract

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 现在面对的问题

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 问题一：无法捕捉高阶关系

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "However, ordinary graph learning methods usually only consider pairwise relationships between data points and cannot unearth higher-order relationships latent in the data." （
普通的图模型每条边只能连接两个样本点，只能描述成对的相似性，而真实数据中往往存在更复杂的、涉及多个样本的群体性关系（即高阶关系），这是普通图模型无法挖掘的）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 问题二：学习与聚类过程脱节

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "And existing graph clustering methods often divide the process of learning the representations and the clustering process into two separate steps, which may lead to unsatisfactory clustering results." （
大部分现有方法采用“两步走”策略：先学习一个数据表示（如图），再在这个表示上进行聚类。这种脱节的学习方式可能导致第一步学到的表示并不最适合第二步的聚类任务，从而产生次优的结果）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 问题三：忽视视图间的互补性与低秩结构

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "Besides, they also tend to consider only intra-view similarity structures and overlook inter-view ones." （
许多方法只关注了每个视图内部的相似性结构，而没有充分考虑不同视图之间的一致性、互补性以及其背后可能存在的低秩结构，未能充分利用多视图数据的核心优势）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 提出方法

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 方法一：利用超图重建缺失视图

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "we use a hypergraph to reconstruct missing views, which can better explore the local structure and higher-order information between sample points."
作者没有使用普通图，而是采用了
超图
。超图的一条边可以连接多个样本，从而能够自然地捕捉到数据中潜在的群体和高阶关系，利用这种更丰富的信息来更准确地重构每个视图中缺失的数据

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 方法二：采用正交非负矩阵分解实现一步聚类

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "Moreover, we use non-negative matrix factorization with orthogonality constraints to equate K-means, which eliminates post-processing operations and avoids the problem of suboptimal results caused by the two-step approach."
作者将带正交约束的非负矩阵分解融入模型。由于该形式在数学上等价于K-means，因此可以在学习数据表示的同时直接得到聚类结果，
将表示学习和聚类这两个步骤统一在一个框架内
，实现了“一步聚类”，避免了两步法的缺陷

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 方法三：使用张量Schatten p-范数挖掘视图间信息

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: "In addition, the tensor Schatten p-norm is used to better capture the complementary information and low-rank structure between the cluster label matrices of multiple views."
作者将所有视图的聚类标签矩阵堆叠成一个
三阶张量
，并对这个张量施加
Schatten p-范数
约束。这个操作旨在挖掘不同视图聚类结果之间的一致性和互补性，并捕捉其背后的低秩结构，从而学习到一个更鲁棒、更一致的全局聚类指示矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z_ii^(v) = 0： “禁止自环”约束

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一个拼图块不能用它自己来重构自己

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 生活例子：在组队完成任务时，你不能把自己算作自己的队友。这个约束迫使每个样本必须寻找其他样本作为其“伙伴”，从而发现数据点之间的真实关联。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z_ij^(v) ≥ 0： “非负”约束

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 拼图块之间的组合系数必须是非负的

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 生活例子：在混合颜料时，你只能添加不同颜色的颜料，而不能“减去”某种颜色。这保证了重构过程的
可加性和物理意义的直观性
，并且通常会诱导出一个
稀疏
的 Z^(v)，即每个样本只由少数几个最近的“邻居”重构，这更符合我们对局部结构的认知。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z^(v) = (Z^(v))^T： “对称”约束

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 要求亲和矩阵是对称的

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 生活例子：如果“小王认为小张是他的好朋友”，那么“小张也应该认为小王是他的好朋友”。这种对称性消除了关系的方向性，简化了后续将 Z^(v) 视为无向图邻接矩阵的过程，为构建一致的超图打下了基础。
