span.span: 项的分解与符号解读

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: X^(v) ∈ ℝ^(d_v × n)： 第 v 个视图的
完整数据矩阵
（包含观测部分和待重建的缺失部分）

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: X^(v) = X_o^(v) W₁^(v) + E^(v) W₂^(v)

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: X_o^(v) ∈ ℝ^(d_v × n_v)：
第 v 个视图中可观测到的数据矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: n_v： 在该视图下实际可被观测到的样本数量。显然，n_v ≤ n

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 第 v 个视图中缺失的数据部分
，这是模型需要
优化求解
的关键变量之一

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 它代表了对于 n - n_v 个在该视图下缺失的样本，我们应该为其赋予什么样的特征值

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: W₁^(v) ∈ ℝ^(n_v × n)：
观测样本的投影矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 它是一个行选择矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 作用： 它将完整的 n 维样本索引空间，映射到 n_v 个有观测值的样本上

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 定义： 对于 X^(v) 的第 j 列（对应第 j 个样本），如果这个样本在该视图下的观测值位于 X_o^(v) 的第 i 列，那么 W₁^(v)(i, j) = 1，否则为0。它的每一列有且仅有一个1

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 缺失样本的投影矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 同样是一个行选择矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 作用： 它将完整的 n 维样本索引空间，映射到 n - n_v 个缺失的样本上

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 定义： 对于 X^(v) 的第 j 列，如果这个样本在该视图下是缺失的，并且其缺失值位于 E^(v) 的第 k 列，那么 W₂^(v)(k, j) = 1，否则为0

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 工作原理：数据的“拼图”与“缝合”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 精确的拼图过程

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 我们有两堆拼图块：

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一堆是已知的 (X_o^(v))：颜色、形状都清楚。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一堆是未知的/空白的 (E^(v))：我们需要根据周围的图案（其他样本和视图信息）来猜测它应该是什么颜色和形状。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 我们有两张“定位图纸” (W₁^(v) 和 W₂^(v))：

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 这两张图纸告诉我们，每一块已知的和空白的拼图块，应该放在最终完整拼图 (X^(v)) 的什么位置上。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 缝合过程：

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: X_o^(v) W₁^(v)： 根据图纸 W₁^(v)，将已知的拼图块精确地放置到完整画布的对应位置上。对于缺失样本的位置，这个操作放置的就是0。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: E^(v) W₂^(v)： 根据图纸 W₂^(v)，将我们优化中的空白拼图块（最终会被模型填上合理的图案）放置到完整画布的对应位置上。对于已有观测样本的位置，这个操作放置的就是0。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: X_o^(v) W₁^(v) + E^(v) W₂^(v)： 将这两个部分相加，就得到了一幅完整的、无缝的拼图。在每一个样本位置上，都有且仅有一个非零值：要么来自观测部分，要么来自模型学习到的缺失部分。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 组合原理

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: “通过投影矩阵实现已知与未知的归一化整合”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 统一表示空间： 定义一个统一的、包含所有样本的完整数据矩阵 X^(v)，无论其是否缺失。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 双路投影： 利用两个互补的、结构化的投影矩阵 W₁^(v) 和 W₂^(v)，作为“交通指挥”，将观测数据 X_o^(v) 和待学习的缺失数据 E^(v) 精准地“投放”到统一表示空间的正确位置上。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 动态构建： 使得“完整数据” X^(v) 成为一个其内容部分依赖于模型优化结果（E^(v)）的动态变量。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 为优化铺平道路： 正是通过这个公式，后续的目标函数（特别是超图正则项）才能直接对缺失数据 E^(v) 的重建过程施加约束和指导，实现了端到端的联合学习。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: L_hyper ∈ ℝ^(n × n)：
超图拉普拉斯矩阵

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 顶点

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: V = {v₁, v₂, ..., vₙ} 表示数据点的集合

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 每个顶点对应一个样本数据点

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 超边

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: E = {e₁, e₂, ..., eₘ}，每条超边是顶点的子集

加权后的、所有超边内的节点特征方差之和

span.span: 组合原理

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 构建高阶关系： 利用一致亲和矩阵 Z* 构建超图 H，将数据点组织成多个"兴趣小组"（超边）。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 数学化群体一致性： 通过超图拉普拉斯矩阵 L_hyper，将"组内成员应相似"这一直觉，转化为可优化的数学目标 Tr(X L_hyper Xᵀ)。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 施加结构约束： 将该目标作为正则项，引导缺失数据 E^(v) 的重建过程，使其重建结果符合其所属各个"小组"的集体特性。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 实现高阶信息利用： 最终，缺失数据不是仅由单个最近邻重建，而是由它所在的所有超边所代表的局部社区共同监督重建，利用了丰富的高阶信息。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 最小化这一项意味着，
在超图中被强连接（位于同一超边）的点，它们的特征也应该相似
。因此，对于一个缺失数据的点，我们可以
利用它在超图中的邻居（高阶近邻）的信息来重建它的缺失特征
。这比只用普通图的最近邻重建更有效、更鲁棒。

span.span: 一致性约束项

span.span: 核心思想：从“视图各自为政”到“强制达成共识”

span.span: 传统方法

span.span: 实现了从
“放任视图差异”
到
“主动强制共识”
的范式转变

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z* 不是一个事后简单平均的结果，而是一个在优化过程中被所有视图共同塑造、同时也反过来约束所有视图的
动态共识中心

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: “我们不能让每个视图‘自说自话’，必须让它们彼此靠近，相互参考，最终融合成一个所有人都认可的‘统一意见书’。”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z^(v) ∈ ℝ^(n × n)： 第 v 个视图学到的
亲和矩阵

span.span: 通过最小化每个视图自身亲和矩阵 Z^(v) 与统一共识 Z* 之间的差异，来拉近所有视图的距离，促使它们趋向一致

span.span: 共识的形成

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: Z* 并非一个外部强加的固定目标，而是通过优化过程
自然涌现
出来的

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: a_v：
第 v 个视图的权重

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: a_v 越大，表示该视图越重要

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 投票权

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 在公式中，每个 Z^(v) 前面的系数是 1/a_v，而不是 a_v

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一个视图越重要（a_v 越大），它的 1/a_v 反而越小，它在形成共识 Z* 时的“投票权”就越小？

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一个视图自身质量越高、越重要，它就应该越“固执己见”，不需要为了迎合共识 Z* 而做出太大改变

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 因此，在计算共识 Z* 时，我们反而要降低这个高质量视图的投票权，让共识 Z* 更多地向它靠拢，而不是让它去迁就一个可能较差的共识

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 换言之，Z* 是
加权平均
的结果，权重是 (1/a_v) / Σ(1/a_v)。a_v 大的视图，其权重小，意味着 Z* 在计算时“少看”它一眼，从而使得 Z* 的值更接近这个高质量的 Z^(v)

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 共识的牵引力

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 双向拉动
的过程

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 共识吸引视图： 对于每个视图 v，该项像一个“弹簧”，一端连着 Z^(v)，另一端连着 Z*。弹簧的“倔强系数”是 1/a_v。a_v 越小（视图质量差），弹簧越“强硬” (1/a_v 很大)，会强行将该视图的 Z^(v) 拉向 Z*。a_v 越大（视图质量好），弹簧越“柔和”，允许它的 Z^(v) 保持更多自身特性。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 视图塑造共识： 与此同时，共识 Z* 本身又是所有 Z^(v) 的加权平均。所有视图都在“拉扯”着 Z*，但权重高的视图拉力更大。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 动态平衡： 在优化的过程中，Z^(v) 和 Z* 相互影响，相互塑造，最终达到一个平衡状态。在这个状态下，每个 Z^(v) 既保留了自己独特的信息，又与一个稳定的、高质量的共识 Z* 保持基本一致。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 组合原理

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: “在加权民主下的双向共识形成”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 确立共识目标： 引入一个统一的关系矩阵 Z* 作为所有视图需要共同逼近的“北极星”。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 实施弹性约束： 通过 Frobenius 范数项，对每个视图施加一个弹性约束，拉力强度与视图自身的重要性 a_v 成反比。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 动态更新共识： 共识 Z* 本身被定义为所有视图亲和矩阵的加权平均，其权重机制确保了高质量视图对共识拥有更大的塑造力。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 实现协同与互补： 最终，所有视图在保持一定特异性的前提下，在一个高质量的共识上达成一致，为后续构建超图提供了稳定、可靠且信息丰富的关系基础。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 一步聚类项

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 核心思想：从“两步走”到“一步到位”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 传统方法

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 绝大多数聚类方法，包括许多先进的深度聚类算法，都遵循一个“两步走”的范式

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: information-icon-font-family; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: center;

span.span: 第一步：通过某种复杂的方法（如自编码器、图神经网络）学习一个良好的数据表示或亲和矩阵 Z^(v)

矩阵层面进行浅层的、后期的融合
，无法挖掘不同视图聚类结果之间深层的、结构化的关联。它们就像
只比较各个部门报告的结论，而不去分析报告内容之间的内在联系

共识与互补性

： 从“一步聚类项”中获取所有视图的聚类指示矩阵 {F^(v)}，并将它们堆叠成张量 𝒫。

： 计算当前张量 𝒫 的Schatten p-范数，并贡献给总损失。

span.span: 反向引导：

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 梯度下降会尝试最小化这个范数，即迫使 𝒫 变得低秩。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 这种压力会通过张量 𝒫 反向传播到每一个视图的聚类指示矩阵 F^(v) 上。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 这种压力告诉每个 F^(v)：“不要特立独行，请调整你自己，让你与其他视图的聚类结果更一致，让我们整体的共识更清晰、更紧凑。”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(24, 57, 77); text-align: left;

span.span: 达成共识
： 在这个约束下，各个 F^(v) 在优化过程中会相互靠近、相互学习。最终，它们不再仅仅是每个视图的最优，而是所有视图共同的最优。

span.span: 不完整多视图多标签学习的发展脉络

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: 开创性工作​​：Tan等人提出的iMVWL模型是该领域的奠基之作，它通过联合优化不完整视图的共享子空间和弱标签分类器，同时学习局部标签相关性，为后续研究奠定了基础。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​后续演进​​：Li等人开发的NAIM3L模型进一步解决了非对齐不完整多视图多标签学习问题，利用多视图共识并挖掘全局和局部标签结构，有效处理非对齐数据。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​深度学习方法​​：随着深度学习的发展，Liu等人提出DICNet（深度实例级对比网络），采用自动编码器进行端到端特征提取，结合对比学习策略和多视图加权融合模块提升分类精度。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​最新进展​​：Liu等人基于语义不变性和原型建模的SIP方法，应用信息瓶颈理论压缩跨视图表示以最大化共享信息，在潜在空间中建模多标签原型。

span.span: 标签噪声处理的研究现状

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: 关键挑战​​：当标签噪声与缺失标签同时存在时，多视图多标签学习的复杂性显著增加。模型需要具备同时整合不完整视图表示并有效处理标签噪声和缺失标签的能力。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​创新方法​​：Chen等人提出了一种广义噪声多标签分类方法，利用标签嵌入网络捕捉特征空间与标签空间之间的复杂相关性，基于标签相关性对噪声预测进行正则化，在该挑战性场景下取得了有希望的结果。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: 第二部分指出，动态超图网络[Jiang et al., 2019; Fu et al., 2022; Zhou et al., 2023]特别适合发现和利用本文问题中复杂的的高阶相关性。这一认识为本文提出基于动态多超图神经网络结合标签过滤矩阵的创新方法提供了理论依据。

span.span: 处理能力局限​​：现有方法在面对不完整视图和标签噪声共存的双重挑战时表现不足，缺乏统一的解决方案。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(25, 56, 76); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​技术缺口​​：多数方法未能充分利用样本间的高阶相关性来辅助校正标签噪声，这成为本文研究的重要突破口。

span.span: ACC：衡量聚类结果与真实标签直接匹配的正确率。值越高，说明有越多的样本被分配到了正确的类别。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: NMI：衡量聚类结果与真实标签之间共享的信息量，并进行归一化。它对簇的大小不敏感，能更好地评估聚类的“结构性”质量。值越高，说明聚类结果与真实类别分布的一致性越好。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: Purity：从“每个簇中最多数样本所属的类别”这个角度来衡量聚类的纯度。值越高，说明簇的“纯净度”越高。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: 这三个指标从不同角度（直接匹配、信息论、簇纯度）综合评价聚类性能，指标值越高代表性能越好，形成了一个全面的评估体系。

span.span: 多视图聚类的演进脉络

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: 多视图聚类算法的核心目标是学习各个视图的表征并将这些信息整合以获得统一的聚类表征

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​早期传统方法​​：普遍采用传统机器学习方法完成多视图聚类任务，随之产生了一系列基于子空间学习的方法，允许多个视图通过利用互补信息共同学习低维映射。与之并行的还有基于图的方法和多核学习方法。然而，这些​​浅层网络结构​​学习更复杂信息的能力有限，使得聚类结果的进一步提升面临挑战。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​深度学习时代​​：与机器学习领域的整体趋势相同，基于深度学习的方法在多视图聚类中占据了主导地位。图结构的引入帮助网络捕捉和利用节点间的交互。因此，近期大部分工作集中于基于图的深度多视图聚类。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: 基于图的深度多视图聚类技术剖析

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: 图扩散卷积的应用​​：图扩散卷积促进了信息在图结构上的传播，从而将局部和全局信息分布到节点间，帮助模型利用数据内部的关系和结构。因此，研究人员提出了通过跨视图图扩散学习来统一多视图数据的图结构进行聚类，在多个基准数据集上取得了可喜的成果。有些研究通过结合基于无监督图平滑性和融合扩散策略的权重学习方案来整合多视图，并结合图扩散卷积技术增强了最终效果。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: ​​对比学习的兴起​​：对比学习能有效处理数据异质性，促进跨视图样本匹配以改进无监督嵌入表征学习。因此，对比学习在多视图分析领域受到广泛关注。例如，有研究提出先获取全局跨视图特征，然后利用双对比校准网络进行优化，并通过实证验证了其有效性。

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: 现有研究的局限

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: “However, these graph-based deep learning methods have not comprehensively extracted and integrated information from multiple scales, thereby resulting in incomplete features of multi-view data.”

div.style: user-select: none; --webkit-user-select:none; line-height: normal; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; overflow: visible; text-overflow: clip; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; display: block; font-family: NeverMind, sans-serif, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(34, 67, 60); text-align: left;

span.span: “然而，这些基于图的深度学习方法​​未能全面地从多尺度提取和整合信息​​，从而导致对多视图数据特征的利用不完整。”
